newsitem.title: JAPAN: Calpis to develop drinks to lower blood pressure.
newsitem.headline: Calpis to develop drinks to lower blood pressure.

text.p: Calpis Food Industry Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to develop new drinks which it said could help people who suffer from hypertension.
The new drinks will contain the same type of amino acids as are in some of its existing beverage products, a company spokesman said.
A Japanese health food industry group said earlier this month it had found that some Calpis beverage products contained amino acids which were helpful in lowering blood pressure, the spokesman said.
He said details of the new products had not yet been decided.

Brokers said Calpis Food's share price rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday after a report in the industrial daily Nikkei Sangyo Shimbun said the company would develop new drinks that would help lower blood pressure. The shares climbed 40 yen to end trading at 765 yen.
